r.정치 구도: A parliamentary republic whose president is chosen by parliament.

t.why: After heavy damage from Hurricane Maria in 2017 and other storms, it stresses climate action on the world stage.
t.rel: An island country in the eastern Caribbean, not to be confused with the Dominican Republic. It is a Caribbean Community member.
t.know: It has a self-governing territory of the Kalinago, the Caribbean's Indigenous people.
t.etext: A volcanic Caribbean island that lives on farming such as bananas and on ecotourism. It earns foreign currency through citizenship by investment.
